title: The nilradical of a seaweed algebra
summary: Seaweed subalgebras of $\mathfrak{gl}(n,\mathbb{C})$ and $\mathfrak{sl}(n,\mathbb{C})$ are combinatorially defined matrix Lie algebras whose index admits a closed-form description in terms of an associated graph called a meander. In this paper, we study the nilradicals of these algebras with our main result establishing an explicit formula for their index in terms of an edge-weighted variation of the meander.
